messages:
Alex: Heads-up — quick UX session notes on the API keys Create flow. Noticed the stepper shows the primary CTA twice (top toolbar + bottom stepper) and the scopes help copy is very long. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.dev/keys-flow-snap.png
Tayla: Yup saw that on mobile — the warning toast sits on top of the bottom CTA and blocks interaction. Also the stepper height pushes the modal off-screen on small viewports.
Mike: Keyboard/focus issue: when opening the modal the tab order is name -> CREATE (top) -> scopes -> cancel. Should be name -> scopes -> create -> cancel. Right now keyboard users can accidentally submit before choosing scopes.
Sophia: Copy nit: the current line 'This key can access all resources' is alarmist and vague. Suggest: 'Grants access to selected resources. Use scopes to restrict access.' Short, less scary, action-oriented.
Alex: Accessibility: when you reveal the secret we currently show the value visually but we don't announce it to screen readers. Need aria-live="polite" and a status update like 'Secret revealed. Use copy button to copy to clipboard.' Also ensure copy button announces 'Copied to clipboard'.
design-bot: Design suggestion: collapse the long help text into a "Why scopes?" disclosure (details/summary) so the modal has less vertical weight. Keep inline one-line hint and move the explanation behind the toggle.
Tayla: Agree on disclosure. Also for empty state: instead of the list header CTA, show a centered card with a compact 'Create your first API key' primary and a smaller 'Learn about scopes' secondary link. That reduces cognitive load for new users.
Mike: One more product question: rotation — should rotate keep previous permissions by default? My read: enterprise customers expect rotation to preserve scopes; but we should show a diff if user changes. If we preserve, we must display 'Scopes preserved' label in the dialog.
Sophia: Yeah default to preserving scopes, but include a small 'Change scopes' link that expands inline. That avoids making rotation a scary destructive flow.
Alex: Action items: Tayla — update prototype to move help text into disclosure and reflow CTAs; Mike — add keyboard/tab-order e2e tests; Sophia — draft alternative microcopy variants; design-bot — add a11y notes (aria-live, focus trap behavior). Can we aim to ship copy + a11y patch this sprint?
Tayla: :thumbsup: I'll push a prototype update and a small PR for copy + disclosure pattern. Prototype ready by EOD Thu.
Mike: I'll add the keyboard tests once tab order is specified. Ping me with the exact DOM order.
Sophia: I'll drop 3 copy options in FigJam for the 'Scopes' help and the rotation confirmation.
aria-bot: accessibility-checker queued — automated scan will run after PR. Reminder: include keyboard tests and aria-live changes in the same patch.
